recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. If PA wants the historical context/EpisodeOfCare search parameter preserved for the current ChargeItem artifact, make that follow-up in HL7/admin-incubator or the owning external package.
issue_request: FHIR-19513 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 ChargeItem. It requested renaming ChargeItem.context to ChargeItem.encounter as 0..1 Encounter, carrying EpisodeOfCare through the workflow-episodeOfCare extension, updating the EpisodeOfCare/context search parameter to read that extension, updating mappings/examples, and not adding reported[x].
initial_application: Core commits 8bce67534b and 68ccf7f675, merged by a2db0e8607, applied the issue while ChargeItem was in core by renaming the element, updating the example and search parameters, and adding ChargeItem to the workflow episodeOfCare extension context list.
additional_context: The current core source no longer contains source/chargeitem or active fhir.ini ChargeItem entries. Commit 71567db3ee removed ChargeItem and ChargeItemDefinition from core, source/modules-fragment.html now links ChargeItem to the HL7 admin-incubator IG, and the Extension Pack source still lists ChargeItem as a workflow-episodeOfCare context. The admin-incubator ChargeItem source has ChargeItem.encounter and an encounter search parameter; any remaining question about retaining a context/EpisodeOfCare compatibility search parameter belongs there.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. An empty external-repo audit commit was published because editing core would touch removed/out-of-build ChargeItem material rather than the current build.
